title: Mysterious object resembling a jellyfish spotted in american skies
excerpt: The sighting of a strange flying object in the skies over the US state of Alaska has been met with astonishment. The unidentified object seemed to look like a jellyfish and a video of the object is quickly gaining traction on social media.
content:
Hassan • November 17, 2026 • World

The sighting of a strange flying object in the skies over the US state of Alaska has been met with astonishment. The unidentified object seemed to look like a jellyfish and a video of the object is quickly gaining traction on social media.

This rare occurrence was reported on June 15, 2026, in Anchorage, Alaska, according to foreign media.

The man was taking pictures with his wife Sarah Jane Osborn when he spotted a strange object in the sky, the media report said. The object in the video seems to be black and silver in colour, and its shape resembles that of a jellyfish.

The object seemed to be floating around above the trees and moved back and forth for about three minutes, Sarah Jane Osborn said. It then suddenly disappeared from sight.

The woman said she and her husband attempted to figure out what the thing was, but he and she could not determine what the thing in the sky was.

The video was posted on social media where different speculations were made. Some people are linking it to an unidentified aerial object, while its actual nature has yet to be established.

The media also said they had seen the mysterious object near the US military base Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson. This is the area where the US Air Force’s advanced F-22 Raptor fighter jets are also stationed. But so far, an official explanation has yet to come as to what the mysterious object was or why it flew.
